_about: Moon sites the new milestones use (Moon sites and milestones plan, section 2; rules in game-design.md, Rules for the new milestones). Types: rules/types.ts SitesFile. Each site is an existing terrain.json feature (feature), a pipeline feature by id (pipeline: { list, id }), or a provisional candidate (provisional, local, radiusM) until the pipeline (Phase 1, P1 to P4) confirms or replaces it. rockSuite names a suite in tuning.json instruments.xray.suites. Keys starting with _ are notes.

sites.name: NW crater
sites.note: Plan candidate: 244 m NNW of the lander, about 8 m deep. Radius from depth / 0.2 (fresh simple crater).

sites.name: East crater
sites.note: Plan candidate: 509 m ENE, about 11 m deep, inner wall up to 39 deg. Radius from depth / 0.2.

sites.name: West crater
sites.note: Plan candidate: 1,055 m W, about 9 m deep. Radius from depth / 0.2.

sites.name: Rolled boulder
sites.note: Placed by design on East crater's floor below its steepest wall. Provisional: East crater's center until P3 gives the wall foot.

sites.name: Hydrogen-rich ground
sites.note: Placed by design on the shaded north slope between Rocky area 1 and Rim viewpoint 1 (average sunlight 5 to 9%, not permanent shadow), 534 m NW. Zone radius: tuning.milestones.hydrogenZoneRadiusM.

sites.name: Rocky area 1 cold patch
sites.note: The existing cold patch in Rocky area 1 (0.05 km2), found in the cold mask from the rocky area's center. Its survey zone is a circle of the same area (52,600 m2, 129 m) at the patch's centroid, measured from cold-mask.png, until the pipeline's coldTraps list gives its outline.

sites.name: East cold trap
sites.note: Plan candidate: 615 m ESE, about one 60 m pixel of the LOLA shadow map (about 2,200 m2, so a 26 m circle); LOLA PSR fraction 0.92.

sites.name: South cold trap
sites.note: Plan candidate: 930 m SSW, 240 m from the wall descent point; about 2,200 m2.

sites.name: Permanently shadowed crater
sites.note: Counts as a cold trap for the survey (decided in Phase 0). Its zone is its permanent-shadow outline.
